security_audit.summary: All 38 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown links, code fences, inline code, metadata URLs, or ordinary reporting language. One medium semantic risk remains because the skill directs agents to persist campaign reports and selected metrics in shared memory without requesting confirmation.

remediation.issue: Campaign metrics and conclusions are saved to persistent report and hot-cache files without an explicit consent or sensitivity check.
remediation.suggestion: Ask before saving, allow a no-persistence mode, and redact confidential client, creator, revenue, and customer data from shared memory.

content.value_statement: Campaign metrics often lack the structure and context stakeholders need. This skill turns existing influencer data into audience-specific reports with insights and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Creates executive, client, internal team, and board reports from supplied campaign metrics.
Organizes reach, engagement, conversion, spend, revenue, ROI, and creator results into clear sections and tables.
Pairs metrics with targets, benchmarks, or prior-period comparisons.
Recommends suitable visual formats for each audience and metric.
Summarizes key learnings, top performers, opportunities, and concrete next steps.
Produces action-item tables with owners and deadlines for team and board audiences.
limitations: It does not calculate raw metrics, attribution, ROI, or ROAS from source data.
It requires existing metrics or user-provided values before creating a complete report.
It does not connect directly to analytics, CRM, or social platforms without host-provided connectors.
Its recommendations depend on the accuracy and completeness of supplied campaign data.

use_cases.title: Executive Campaign Review
use_cases.description: Summarize business outcomes, ROI, major lessons, and investment recommendations for leadership.

use_cases.title: Client Results Delivery
use_cases.description: Present campaign performance, creator highlights, audience insights, and next steps in a polished client report.

use_cases.title: Team Performance Retrospective
use_cases.description: Document detailed metrics, content patterns, budget variance, learnings, and assigned actions for future campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Campaign Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a campaign report for [campaign name]. The audience is [executive, client, team, or board]. Use these metrics: [metrics].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when campaign metrics are ready and a standard report is needed.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Executive Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an executive summary for [campaign and period]. Compare results with [targets or prior period]. Highlight ROI, key outcomes, and one recommendation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for leadership updates that require concise business conclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Client Performance Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a client report for [campaign]. Include objectives, delivery, performance, top creators, audience insights, recommendations, and next steps. Use [provided data].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when an agency must explain delivered value and future opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Detailed Team Retrospective
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop a team retrospective for [campaign]. Analyze results by platform, creator, content format, budget, and efficiency. Add evidence-based recommendations, owners, and deadlines.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced operational analysis and future campaign planning.

output_examples.input: Create an executive report for a holiday campaign with $50,000 spend, $165,000 revenue, and 3.5 million reach.
output_examples.output:
Holiday Campaign Executive Summary

The campaign generated $165,000 from $50,000 in spend, producing 230% ROI and 3.3 ROAS.

Recommendation: Increase the next-quarter budget while prioritizing the best-performing creators and product demonstration content.

output_examples.input: Summarize a client campaign that exceeded its reach target by 20 percent but missed its conversion target by 15 percent.
output_examples.output:
Client Performance Summary

Reach exceeded target by 20%, showing strong awareness delivery. Conversions finished 15% below target, indicating a gap after engagement.

Next step: Test clearer calls to action and improve landing-page alignment.

output_examples.input: Create an internal team report with creator results, content findings, and next actions.
output: Top performers: Identify creators that exceeded reach, engagement, and conversion benchmarks.
Content learning: Compare product demonstrations, tutorials, and lifestyle posts using consistent metrics.
Actions: Assign creator renewal decisions, brief revisions, and measurement updates to named owners with deadlines.

best_practices: Provide validated metrics, campaign dates, audience, targets, and comparison periods before requesting the report.
Match detail to the audience and explain every important metric with relevant context.
Review confidential data and confirm persistence preferences before saving reports or conclusions.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent missing results, targets, benchmarks, or financial values.
Do not use one report structure for executives, clients, and delivery teams.
Do not present isolated metrics without explaining performance, causes, implications, and next actions.

faq.question: Does this skill calculate ROI or ROAS?
faq.answer: No. It reports supplied values and expects a separate analyzer or calculator to produce validated financial metrics.

faq.question: Which report audiences are supported?
faq.answer: It supports executive, client, internal team, and board audiences with different detail levels and priorities.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign name, period, audience, objectives, targets, spend, revenue, reach, engagement, conversions, and creator results when available.

faq.question: Can it work without live platform connections?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply the campaign metrics directly, and the skill can create the report without live integrations.

faq.question: Does it create charts?
faq.answer: It recommends suitable chart types and report layouts. Actual chart rendering depends on the host and available tools.

faq.question: Where can reports be saved?
faq.answer: The skill proposes workspace memory paths. Confirm the location and remove sensitive information before enabling persistence.
